description: This header file defines the external API for the AnscDaemonSocketUdp component, including function prototypes for managing UDP socket state, sending and receiving data, and configuring connection parameters within the ANSC framework.

methods.name: AnscDkuoGetPeerAddress
methods.description: Gets the IP address of the peer endpoint.

methods.name: AnscDkuoSetPeerAddress
methods.description: Sets the IP address of the peer endpoint.

methods.name: AnscDkuoGetPeerPort
methods.description: Retrieves the port number of the peer endpoint.

methods.name: AnscDkuoSetPeerPort
methods.description: Sets the port number of the peer endpoint.

methods.name: AnscDkuoGetDaemonServer
methods.description: Gets the handle to the daemon server object.

methods.name: AnscDkuoSetDaemonServer
methods.description: Associates a daemon server object handle.

methods.name: AnscDkuoGetDaemonEngine
methods.description: Retrieves the daemon engine handle.

methods.name: AnscDkuoSetDaemonEngine
methods.description: Sets the daemon engine handle.

methods.name: AnscDkuoGetClientContext
methods.description: Gets the client context associated with the socket.

methods.name: AnscDkuoSetClientContext
methods.description: Sets the client context.

methods.name: AnscDkuoGetPacket
methods.description: Retrieves the current packet handle.

methods.name: AnscDkuoSetPacket
methods.description: Sets the packet handle.

methods.name: AnscDkuoReturn
methods.description: Returns the socket object to its pool or marks it as available.

methods.name: AnscDkuoReset
methods.description: Resets the socket object's state.

methods.name: AnscDkuoFinish
methods.description: Completes pending operations and finalizes the socket.

methods.name: AnscDkuoOpen
methods.description: Opens or initializes the UDP socket.

methods.name: AnscDkuoClose
methods.description: Closes the UDP socket.

methods.name: AnscDkuoEnableRecv
methods.description: Enables or disables receiving on the socket.

methods.name: AnscDkuoEnableSend
methods.description: Enables or disables sending on the socket.

methods.name: AnscDkuoRecv
methods.description: Receives data through the UDP socket.

methods.name: AnscDkuoSend
methods.description: Sends data through the UDP socket.
